{{Quote|We can ''blast'' our enemies into ''dust''!|Aleema Keto|audio=Aleema-DLotS.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Force blast''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and neutral [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], that when conjured, projected concentrated blasts of pure dark side energy at objects or opponents, usually with devastating effects. This ability was even further expanded upon, resulting in the [[Sickening blast]].

Using one's hands, the conjurer could project focused blasts of dark side energy, that could obliterate objects, or destroy living beings or creatures. At first, users would experience moderate difficulty in controlling such powerful dark side energy. With practice, the aspiring [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerer]] could learn to direct the energies into a power that could obliterate anything in its path. Sometimes the user would suffer burns to their flesh, but feel no pain. While its effects were enhanced if the wearer was in possession of a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]], the amulet was not required.

A universal version of this power merely compressed air to be blasted at enemies—a version used frequently between 40-44 ABY.<ref name=":0">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref><ref name=":1">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|My hand&hellip; the flesh is ''burned''! But I feel ''no pain''!|Exar Kun|<ref name="DLotS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]] of [[3998 BBY]], [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]], the sorcerer [[King/Legends|King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], used this ability to overwhelm the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] sent to free [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]]. Drawing on his connection to the dark side of the Force, Ommin blasted both [[Nomi Sunrider]] and [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] with what was described as "infinite hatred." Just as he prepared to finish Qel-Droma with another wave of energy, the young Jedi destroyed his [[Ommin's mechanical exoskeleton|armature]] to incapacitate him.<ref name="TFNU">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''</ref> While on his own progression down the dark side, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] learned this ability after acquiring a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] from the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of [[Freedon Nadd]], who he destroyed with a Force blast. While just a beginner, Kun soon found this power was to his liking, practicing it on the hapless [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. He mastered the ability rather quickly and repaid his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] Nadd by blasting his astral form at close range, which resulted in a second death for Nadd. During the [[Battle of Empress Teta|Second Battle of Empress Teta]] when Kun [[Duel in the Iron Citadel (Exar Kun)|stormed]] the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Iron Citadel/Legends|palace]] in [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]], sorceress [[Aleema Keto]] used a Force blast on Exar Kun, who repaid her with an even stronger blast that knocked her across the room.<ref name="DLotS" /> Later, Kun's ghost on Yavin 4 would blast [[Gantoris]] to death when he refused to turn to the dark side.<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], this technique saw a resurgence of use by the Jedi (and Sith) most notably in the hands of [[Darth Caedus]]<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> and his [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|mother]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

Later [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]] were users, and the members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] were prevalent practitioners.<ref name="Invincible" /><ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
